Points of contact: for Defence Command — Aldmoor military liaison officer (joint planning, operational picture, deconfliction); for the Civil Contingencies Agency — Aldmoor civil-logistics coordination lead (repair and resupply support). Working-level details will be exchanged through agreed channels immediately.

Capability readiness: our surveillance and overflight aircraft are at readiness and can be brought to bear within approximately 24 hours of the Cabinet's commencement notice, operating strictly within the agreed areas. Our cable-repair vessel can be on site within two days of a request and is ready to deploy for survey and repair on the Cabinet's instruction, coordinated through the CCA and Defence Command.

We will conduct our support strictly within the Cabinet's terms, in support of the civil-led response directed by Skarö County Administration. We will align the timing and public framing of our assistance with the Cabinet and announce nothing beyond what Vardland has already set out. As previously offered, our sanitised technical assessment concerning the survey vessel linked to the fault is available through the agreed channel for the Cabinet's use, with our collection methods protected.

We stand ready for joint planning with Defence Command and to begin work with the CCA at your word.

From the Kingdom of Aldmoor to the Drevnian Federation.

Thank you for your message. We share your commitment to the safety of civilian shipping and to the uninterrupted resupply of Skarö and the repair of its cable, and we note your assurance that exercise manoeuvres will stay well clear of the shipping routes serving the island and of any repair operation.

Aldmoor welcomes the establishment of a practical working-level channel for maritime deconfliction and safety of navigation in the Eastern Sea, and we will task our maritime coordination centre to engage with your designated counterparts as a technical, operational matter. Preventing misunderstandings before they arise is in everyone's interest.

For clarity on the basis and limits of our activity: Aldmoor acts only at the explicit, time-boxed invitation of the Vardland government and on terms Vardland controls and may adjust at any time — limited surveillance and overflight in defined areas and technical support to the repair and resupply, with no ground forces on Skarö. Our support is a proportionate measure to protect a civilian emergency operation and ends when the cable is restored or Vardland's consent term expires. Suggestions of 'militarisation' do not reflect the character or limits of this support.

We trust all parties will let established facts, fuel and repairs proceed without interference. Our channels remain open.

Kingdom of Aldmoor — Statement on Skarö.

The Kingdom of Aldmoor confirms and accepts the Vardland Cabinet's decision of today to accept our assistance on limited, time-boxed terms, and we will implement it strictly as the Cabinet has set out. At Vardland's invitation and under its full authority: Aldmoor aircraft will conduct surveillance and overflight over defined areas of the Eastern Sea covering the Skarö cable route and the fuel resupply corridor, and Aldmoor will provide technical and logistics support to the repair and resupply effort, coordinated with Vardland's Civil Contingencies Agency and Defence Command.

Our support is confined to the areas and period Vardland has defined. There will be no Aldmoor ground forces on Skarö. Consent runs until the cable is restored or 30 days, whichever is earlier, and Vardland may adjust or end our role at any time. The response remains civil-led and is directed by Skarö County Administration; we are glad to support it.

We call on all parties to exercise restraint, to respect international law and the safety of civilian shipping, and to let established facts — not speculation — guide the discussion. The people of Skarö need facts, fuel and a repaired cable. That is what our support is for.

From the Vardland Cabinet. We confirm formally: the Kingdom of Vardland consents to the limited assistance you have set out, and authorises activation now on the agreed terms. Maritime surveillance patrols in the designated Eastern Sea areas may commence within approximately one day. Overflight of Vardland airspace will be authorised by the Cabinet case-by-case — narrowly scoped, time-limited and coordinated through agreed points of contact; we will issue the first authorisations together with Defence Command. We accept your engineering and cable-repair assistance, to operate within our repair scheme and the County's priorities, and we note your contingency logistics and fuel offer for decisions should the outage extend beyond two weeks. No foreign ground forces on Skarö at any stage. The arrangement is time-bound to cable restoration or 30 days, whichever is earlier, and renewable only by a new Cabinet decision; scope, place and time may be adjusted on notice. Vardland retains full authority over all activity in its territory, territorial waters and airspace. Please provide points of contact for joint planning with Defence Command and the Civil Contingencies Agency, and transmit the sanitised technical brief through secure channels; our technical investigation will weigh it on its merits. Attribution remains exclusively the Vardland Cabinet's decision.

From the Vardland Cabinet, in reply to your private communication. We confirm receipt and note your assurances. Vardland directs and resources the civil-led response on Skarö with national means, under rules of authority that are clear; any question of foreign presence on our territory, in our territorial waters or in our airspace is a sovereign decision of the Vardland Cabinet, and we will make it in the interests of our own people. We agree on the value of practical, technical measures to prevent misunderstanding in the Eastern Sea. Our Defence Command is authorised to open a working-level channel with your military for the deconfliction of civilian maritime traffic, including the resupply corridor to Skarö and any cable-repair operation. We expect that channel to be professional and strictly technical. We intend a full, transparent, evidence-based investigation; should it raise questions for the Federation through official channels, we will rely on the cooperation you have expressed. We trust that the Drevnian exercise will remain in international waters and well clear of civilian shipping and repair operations, and we will hold all parties to that standard. Our channels remain open.

Statement from the Cabinet of Vardland. The Government of Vardland coordinates the response to the Skarö cable failure through clear official channels: Skarö County Administration directs the civil emergency on the island; the Civil Contingencies Agency coordinates national supplies; our armed forces support the County at its formal request, within domestic law. The fuel tanker is at sea and generator reinforcement is being dispatched. The failure of the cable cannot be repaired in a matter of hours; restoration will take days at the earliest, and we will publish confirmed timelines as facts are established. The cause has not been established. The Government will not speculate, and it will not attribute the failure to anyone — at home or abroad — without evidence. In line with our earlier announcement, we have now formally agreed limited, time-bound international assistance, with the Kingdom of Aldmoor, for maritime surveillance and cable repair, on terms set by Vardland: no foreign ground forces, full Vardland authority over all activity on our territory, in our waters and in our airspace, and a defined end point. This is prudent protection of an undersea lifeline and of the civilian supply route — not an escalation. The Government judges the powers currently in place sufficient for the response under way and keeps the alert posture under continuous review. We call on all parties to act with restraint, to respect international law, and to keep civilian shipping and repair operations safe. The people of Skarö will not be left without power, and they will not be left to speculate alone. Facts will be established and published.

From Skarö County to CCA and Defence Command — confirmation and coordination.

1) Tanker: County confirms the priority berth. The port operator is sequencing offloading against ferry slots and will confirm load limits. Please provide the confirmed ETA and cargo volume so the port can finalise berth readiness.

2) Defence Liaison Skarö: accepted as the single on-scene liaison point. All county tasking will flow through the County emergency staff. Please activate the point now and hand us the surveillance picture and tanker programme once CCA fixes ETA; continue traffic advisories relevant to the tanker and, later, any repair operation.

3) Generators/sat-comms: please confirm delivery slots and air movement times. County priority for connection: hospital and county crisis centre first, then water plant and backup power plant.

4) Public update: County agrees to the joint update once tanker ETA and delivery slots are firm. We will publish confirmed ferry and travel information through County and official channels today so residents have practical schedules. We will keep the response visibly civil-led; where tasks put armed forces personnel near populated areas, we will describe their role plainly in advance so the public is not left to infer a 'takeover'.

Regards, County Emergency Staff.

From the Drevnian Federation to the Vardland Cabinet.

We confirm our readiness to establish the working-level channel you have described. Our Eastern Sea coordination staff will designate senior naval counterparts to your Defence Command without delay. The channel will be strictly professional and technical, covering safety of navigation for civilian shipping serving Skarö, the resupply corridor and any cable-repair operation, and we will ensure our exercise remains in international waters and airspace and keeps clear of the areas you define.

We reiterate our offer of a Drevnian civilian cable-repair vessel, available at your request and on your terms, with no conditions attached. We see no reason civilian capacity for this work should be in short supply while the island is without its main connection.

We support your stated intention of a full, transparent, evidence-based investigation and will cooperate through official channels should it raise questions for the Federation. Predictability and professional conduct on all sides serve the people of Skarö, and we willhould stay that way.

Prime Minister's Office to the Government of Aldmoor — commencement notice and activation.

The Cabinet formally activates the agreed assistance package with immediate effect, strictly on the terms already confirmed.

1) Surveillance and overflight: stand up now over the defined Eastern Sea areas covering the Skarö cable route and the fuel resupply corridor. We take you at your stated readiness and expect first aircraft contributions within approximately 24 hours, with an initial read on the resupply corridor and the exercise area at the earliest opportunity. First overflight authorisations for the defined areas are granted under the agreed scope; any further case-by-case authorisations continue through the Defence Command liaison.

2) Technical and logistics support: begin coordination with the Civil Contingencies Agency without delay on the repair and resupply effort. We ask that your cable-repair vessel remain at readiness as an approved contingency, to be activated only on our instruction.

3) Joint planning: commence immediately through the agreed points of contact (Defence Command military liaison; CCA civil-logistics coordination lead).

4) Please share your sanitised technical assessment on the survey vessel via the agreed channel; we will use it for our internal evidence review, with our collection methods protected.

5) Scope and governance unchanged: no ground forces on Skarö; operations only within the defined areas and period; consent runs until the cable is restored or 30 days, whichever is earlier, renewable only by Cabinet; Vardland retains full authority and may adjust on notice. Public communication remains aligned with us through the agreed channel — nothing beyond what the Cabinet has set out.

The response remains civil-led and is directed by Skarö County Administration; your support is under Vardland's authority and on Vardland's terms. We will communicate further decisions promptly.

Skarö County Administration — Defence Command response to your support request. Confirmed: Defence Liaison Skarö is designated as the single on-scene liaison point for your crisis centre; all tasking coordination should run through that channel. First read on the surveillance picture around Skarö:

- Our maritime and air surveillance of the approaches, the tanker route and the defined infrastructure sites is active and continuous.
- The Drevnian exercise remains in international waters. Public assurances state it will stay clear of civilian shipping routes serving Skarö, the cable landing site and any repair operation; we are holding them to that and monitoring for any change.
- No threatening movement toward Skarö's approaches or Vardland territorial waters has been identified at this time. This is a snapshot assessment, not a guarantee, and we will advise immediately if the picture changes.

We will coordinate route monitoring as soon as you confirm the tanker programme and ETA. Engineering support to establish and keep safe access at the cable landing site and port continues as tasked. Protection of the cable landing site, port, backup power plant and ferry terminal remains low-profile. Response remains civil-led under your direction.

Cabinet — Defence Command, confidential update for your continuous review of the alert posture.

We are executing the County's support request: single liaison established, surveillance and engineering tasks under way, protection of the cable landing site, port, backup power plant and ferry terminal at low profile. We will not overreach; the response remains civil-led.

For your review, our assessment stands with mixed confidence: (1) sabotage of the cable is plausible but not proven; we have position/speed data on a Drevnian-contracted survey vessel near the route before the failure and will forward it to the investigation without attribution; (2) the Drevnian exercise is larger than last year and includes landing ships — most likely signalling, but a limited seizure cannot be excluded and would be hard to reverse once begun; (3) the Skarö garrison can cover the airfield or the port/cable landing site, but not both for long; (4) once a decision is made, first units by air arrive in about a day and heavier units by sea in about two — both require heightened alert.

Nothing has changed since your statement, and we fully respect your judgement that current powers suffice for the present phase. We recommend the posture be kept under active review and ask that we may brief you in detail at your convenience, including the surveillance evidence, so that any decision is based on the fullest picture. We stand ready to execute within hours of any declaration.

CCA to Skarö County Administration — confirming the detailed supply programme for publication, as you requested.

1) Fuel: our contracted tanker has sailed from the mainland port and is en route, ETA at Skarö approaches approximately 24 hours, subject to safe passage. Berth priority at Skarö port stands as granted. Offloading will run in sequential slots as advised, with onward distribution prioritised for hospitals, water, heating and essential services. We will confirm the detailed storage and distribution plan with you once cargo details are firm.

2) Generators: the mobile generator package (covering about half of backup load should primary units fail) moves on the same sea leg, matched to your connection sites and staff. Satellite communication kits for the county hospital and the crisis centre are dispatched by air as priority, with standby for the water plant if supply allows; we will coordinate arrival so county staff can install and test before reliance.

3) Defence: route monitoring and safety advisories for the tanker's passage are confirmed through Defence Liaison Skarö, and the programme is handed over as agreed. Support remains transport, engineering and surveillance only, at your request, civil-led in public face.

4) Public information: we agree to the joint public update once these schedules are fixed, published on county and CCA channels together. Proposed factual baseline: cause of the cable failure not yet established; County directs the response; Defence supports at County request; confirmed times for tanker, offloading and generators; where to find official updates. We will carry island radio as the primary channel. Let us know the publication slot you propose and we will hold it.

CCA to Cabinet — follow-up on two pending decisions and one coordination note, with today's confirmed picture.

1) Cross-county supply authority: fuel remains the binding constraint — roughly five days of island stock, about one day's tanker transit, and resupply must be repeated and sustained while the cable is repaired (the contracted repair vessel cannot sail for several days). A targeted delegation or partial heightened-alert limited to supply functions would let us direct fuel, generators and medical supplies across counties before, not after, a shortfall. We ask for a decision before day three, as previously proposed.

2) Joint public-information plan: we request approval to stand up the CCA information desk — radio-forward for the island plus official channels — with rebuttals to the four circulating narratives (neglect, military takeover, Drevnian submarines, Aldmoor base), all set against a single factual baseline with no attribution. The information monitor shows county updates are trusted on the island but reach few beyond it; a coordinated national echo closes that gap.

3) Drevna: its public statement holds the cable-repair vessel offer open. We maintain our advice to hold without acceptance — the repair path is covered by the contracted vessel once it sails together with Aldmoor technical support, and accepting now would concede agenda-setting. Attribution discipline unchanged: no attribution without evidence.

Concrete delivery schedules for the tanker, offloading and generators are being finalised with the County for publication; we stand ready to execute on your decisions.

From the Government of Aldmoor to the Vardland Cabinet. Aldmoor accepts the terms of your formal consent and is ready to begin on your authority. To confirm our standing arrangements:

1. Maritime surveillance patrols in the designated Eastern Sea areas can commence within approximately 24 hours of your commencement notice.
2. Our cable-repair vessel can depart within two days of your request and will operate within your repair scheme and Skarö County's priorities; it will not enter Vardland waters without your approval and will coordinate through the common operational picture.
3. Points of contact are confirmed through our missions: Defence Command for joint planning and military liaison; the Civil Contingencies Agency for repair and resupply coordination.

We therefore formally request: (a) the commencement notice; (b) the first case-by-case overflight authorisations; and (c) confirmation that the sanitised technical brief has reached your technical investigation through secure channels — we transmitted it via the agreed route and stand ready to provide any further sanitised material your investigation considers useful. Attribution remains exclusively yours.

All Aldmoor activity will remain within the scope, place and time Vardland has set, under Vardland's full authority, with no ground forces, and will end at cable restoration or 30 days, whichever is earlier, renewable only by a new Cabinet decision. We are ready to open joint planning with Defence Command immediately so that repair can begin the moment your civil authorities confirm safe access.

Minister — thank you for your letter. Our working-level technical and safety-of-navigation channel is now established; Aldmoor's maritime coordination centre is the point of contact and will respond on routine notice.

Let us be equally plain about our own posture, so there is no misunderstanding. Aldmoor acts in this situation only at Vardland's invitation and under its authority. Our assistance is limited and time-bound, confined to the areas Vardland has designated, involves no ground forces and no permanent presence, and ends at cable restoration or within 30 days, whichever is earlier. We are not seeking a base on Skarö, and we will not create one. What we are doing is protecting an undersea lifeline and a civilian supply route at a friend's request.

We take your assurances at face value: that the Drevnian exercise remains fully within international waters and airspace, well clear of civilian shipping, of the cable landing site, and of repair and resupply operations serving Skarö. Through this channel we expect early notice of any movement so that no one is surprised. Should Vardland accept your civilian repair-vessel offer, that is Vardland's sovereign decision; our own technical support to repair proceeds only at Vardland's direction and within its repair scheme.

We have no quarrel with Drevna either, and see no reason this situation should change that.

Minister — thank you for your letter and for the clarity of Aldmoor's posture. We take it at face value, and we expect our own assurances to be taken in the same spirit.

The exercise continues to be conducted wholly within international waters and airspace, at announced positions well clear of the cable route, the landing site and the shipping lanes serving Skarö. We will honour the working-level channel and give early notice of any movement that might bear on navigation or on repair and resupply operations on the Eastern Sea routes. That is not a concession to anyone; it is how responsible maritime nations behave, and it serves all our interests.

We likewise note with satisfaction that Aldmoor's assistance is limited, time-bound and exercised only at Vardland's invitation and under its authority, with no ground forces and no permanent presence. We will hold everyone, ourselves included, to those terms.

Our own civilian cable-repair vessel offer to Vardland remains open and unconditional. It is a purely civilian measure; Vardland may accept or decline it as it sees fit, and we will make no issue of it either way.

We have no quarrel with Aldmoor and see no reason this situation should change that.

The Drevnian Federation's response to the Skarö cable failure: (1) our civilian cable-repair vessel remains ready to sail with Vardland's consent; (2) we stand ready to supply fuel and generators through ordinary commercial channels; and (3) we propose a Safety-of-Navigation and Operations Protocol for the Eastern Sea near Skarö — defined transit corridors, no-go zones around the cable route, the landing site and repair operations, and pre-notification of all military and civilian movements — open to Vardland, Aldmoor and all parties. A civilian emergency should be solved with civilian means, transparently and on a limited timetable. We invite Vardland and Aldmoor to join this protocol so that every state's activity around the island is visible, and the islanders' needs — not rivalries — decide the response.

We take your public commitment at face value: assistance limited, time-bound, no ground forces, no permanent presence, revocable by Vardland. To keep it that way and prevent any incident, we propose both our forces file movements under a common Safety-of-Navigation Protocol: defined corridors, no-go zones around the repair site and civilian shipping, and pre-notification. We will submit our corridor plan immediately and invite yours in return. Drevna has no quarrel with Aldmoor; let us keep it that way.

Statement from the Vardland Cabinet on Skarö.

Our response to the outage is and will remain civil-led and lawful. Skarö County directs the island's emergency response. The Civil Contingencies Agency is prioritising hospitals, water and heating, and the Cabinet has now given it the authority it needs to keep fuel, generators and medical supplies moving to Skarö without interruption.

Repairing the cable is the first priority. Working with our ally Aldmoor under host-nation consent — strictly scoped to the cable route and landing site, time-bound, with no ground forces — we have activated a civilian repair capability so the fault can be reached as soon as safe access is secured. We will not speculate about the cause: the cause has not been established, we will not attribute it to any state without evidence, and we invite every state, including Drevna, to join a transparent, evidence-based investigation and to extend to its own military movements near the cable route the same transparency it asks of others.

We have not declared heightened alert. There is currently no basis for it, and it would not help the islanders.

To the people of Skarö: your power and heat are prioritised, resupply is under way, and repair work is starting. Help is on the way.

Dear colleagues. We confirm your commencement notice is in force, and we have received the sanitised technical brief via the secured route. The Cabinet hereby activates the cable-repair vessel under our host-nation consent, with the agreed scope and limits: cable route and landing site only; no ground forces; time-bound to cable restored or 30 days, whichever is earlier; renewable only by the Cabinet. Please confirm the vessel's sail time and expected arrival, coordinate the repair window and port/berth priority with Defence Command and Skarö County, and continue sharing surveillance indications with Defence Command on an un-attributed evidence basis. We will keep publicly framing this as scoped civilian repair support under host-nation consent. Overflight authorisations already issued stand.

Formal reply through the working-level channel. Vardland thanks Drevna for its civilian gestures. We are managing Skarö's resupply through ordinary commercial channels under our own authority and with County direction, and our own contracted and allied repair arrangements are already in train; we therefore will not be requesting the offered vessel. On the Safety-of-Navigation and Operations Protocol: we cannot accept it as tabled. It cannot bind Aldmoor without Aldmoor's own sovereign consent, and Vardland already notifies its movements under applicable national and international rules. We remain genuinely ready to cooperate on safety: we invite Drevna to apply to its own exercise the same transparency it proposes for others, to keep its forces clear of the cable route, the landing site and the repair operation, and to join a transparent, evidence-based investigation of the outage through agreed channels. We will judge restraint by conduct.

Cabinet — I request a scoped, time-limited decision authorising Defence Command to reinforce Skarö: an air-delivered element to the airfield and cable-landing area within about one day, a sea-delivered element within about two, to protect the cable landing site, port and airfield through the repair and restoration window. This needs no heightened-alert declaration and no reservist call-up; it builds on Skarö County's standing support request inside the civil-led framework, is proportionate and time-bound, and stays renewable by the Cabinet. The standing garrison can cover the airfield or the port and cable landing, but not both for long, and the repair window — while the Drevnian exercise continues unconstrained — is the peak-exposure moment; forces must be decided now to arrive in time. In the same decision I propose a Defence Command-coordinated underwater survey of the fault during the repair, to put evidence before the transparent cause investigation. Readiness: air ~1 day, sea ~2 days from your decision. We will keep the posture low-visibility and the public frame civil-led, with the deployment justified openly as protection of critical infrastructure under the County-led response.

Defence Liaison Skarö — in support of your civil-led response, and building on your standing support request, we stand ready under a scoped Cabinet authorization to extend protection to the cable landing site, port and airfield through the repair and restoration window. No change to County direction; ours remains strictly supporting. Surveillance picture and tanker programme remain per your tasking; we confirm delivery slots with you once the Civil Contingencies Agency fixes the tanker ETA.

Repair-window coordination: shared surveillance picture and deconfliction with the Drevnian exercise are stood up. We have requested a scoped, time-bound Cabinet authorization to place protective elements at the cable landing site, port and airfield through the repair and restoration window — capability that also underwrites your vessel's safe access to the fault. We propose a coordinated underwater survey of the fault during the repair to secure cause evidence for the transparent investigation. Consent boundaries are respected: nothing beyond the Cabinet's scoped package without a further Cabinet decision.

County — schedules firming: tanker ETA ~24h at approaches subject to safe passage, priority berth, sequential offload; generator package on the same sea leg at your connection sites; satcom kits for hospital and crisis centre by air. Propose we publish the joint factual baseline once you confirm cargo volumes and ferry/travel timing. On protection: please sign off the formal, time-bound County request for scoped armed protection of the port/cable-landing site and airfield through the restoration window under military-support-to-civil, at your request — CCA will sequence any visible presence behind the civilian plan and the Cabinet retains the authorisation decision. Distribution priorities remain hospitals, water, heating, essential services.

Cabinet — CCA is executing the delegated supply direction: fuel, generators and medical supplies now moving across counties to Skarö; tanker ~24h, generators and satcom by air as briefed; the joint information desk is going live with the County-CCA factual baseline. Skarö County has confirmed an explicit, time-bound request for scoped armed protection of the port, cable-landing site and airfield through the restoration window; CCA commits to subordinating any visible presence to the civilian plan and framing it as infrastructure protection under the civil-led response. Request your single authorisation now so protection is in place for restoration. No heightened alert or attribution sought; the Drevna line is unchanged.

Joint County–CCA update: essential supply is on the way — the fuel tanker approaches Skarö within about 24 hours, with generators and satellite communications arriving by air; hospitals, water and heating remain the first priority under County direction. The response stays civil-led: the County directs, national agencies supply, and Defence supports only at a civil request. The cable's cause is under a transparent investigation; we will publish facts as they are confirmed and reject speculation that divides us. We ask everyone to respect the safety of the repair operation and of civilian traffic.

County to CCA: confirming the on-island programme for the repair window. Tanker berthing proceeds at the priority berth after ferry sequencing, with distribution in the agreed priority order — hospital and crisis centre first, then water plant and backup plant. County will confirm exact cargo volumes from the manifest at offload, and will confirm generator/satcom installation and testing slots once the sea and air legs land. County proposes the joint factual baseline and confirmed ferry/travel information be published through the information desk and island radio as soon as tanker arrival is firm — propose the slot and County will lead distribution of the message on-island. Maintain the logistics interface with the Aldmoor repair operation (berthing, fuel, communications) through the repair window so restoration stays on track for the following turn. County retains direction on-island throughout.

To the Cabinet from Skarö County Administration: the County formally transmits its scoped, time-bound request for armed protection of the port, cable-landing site and airfield through the restoration window, under military-support-to-civil, for a single Cabinet authorisation. Terms agreed with CCA and Defence, on which the County's support rests: coordination through County emergency staff via Defence Liaison Skarö; any visible armed presence sequenced behind the civilian information and supply plan, with a County-agreed civil-led public message before any arrival; low-profile staging; time-bound and renewable by the Cabinet only. The County continues to direct the civil response and asks that any authorisation not constrain County-directed tanker, ferry or repair-access movements. This request is the explicit civil-authority basis for the protection task; the County stands ready to execute the agreed sequencing and framing the moment a decision is taken.

Skarö County Administration to the residents of Skarö: the County continues to direct the island's response. Backup power is keeping hospitals, water and heating running, and fuel and supplies are arriving now — fuel, mobile generators, medical stocks and communications kits. The cable repair operation is under way; restoration is expected within days. The response remains civil-led: should protective measures be needed, they are time-bound, coordinated with the County and will never be a military takeover of the response. Confirmed ferry and supply information is being published through the joint information desk and island radio — please use official channels. Departures remain a free choice; no movement restrictions are ordered. The County is here, working for you, and will keep you informed.

Operational confirmation to the Cabinet. Our cable-repair vessel is en route and will arrive in the repair window; we are confirming ETA and berth/repair-window coordination with Defence Command and Skarö County and will hold to your repair scheme and the County's priorities. Maritime surveillance and overflight stand up on station within approximately 24 hours across the designated areas — the cable route and the fuel resupply corridor — with an un-attributed picture delivered to Defence Command and your government. We will execute strictly within the consented scope: time-bound, no ground forces, nothing outside the defined areas, renewable only by the Cabinet. We support the County's formalised scoped protection request and Defence Command's scoped reinforcement request as the means to underwrite the repair window; the decision remains entirely Vardland's. We continue to share sanitised technical briefs only and protect our sources; attribution stays with the Cabinet.

Working-level confirmation from Aldmoor. Our repair vessel's ETA will be passed via the established liaison; we will conform to the County's civil-led sequencing and the CCA logistics interface for berthing, fuel and communications. Our surveillance picture over the designated areas will be shared on an un-attributed basis; we stand ready to integrate with your deconfliction arrangement and to facilitate a Defence Command-coordinated underwater survey of the fault within the consented scope. No element of our force operates outside the consented areas or beyond the time-bound consent. We support the County's formalised protection request and Defence Command's reinforcement request.

Aldmoor is on and around Skarö's waters only at Vardland's invitation, for a scoped, time-bound cable-repair and surveillance-support role under Vardland's full authority. No ground forces. No base. The response on Skarö remains civil-led and directed by Skarö County. We are here to help restore the cable that keeps the island's power and data running, and our presence ends at cable restoration or with the end of Vardland's consent, whichever comes first — and that is Vardland's decision alone.

From the Vardland Cabinet to Aldmoor.

(1) Airspace: the Cabinet consents — scoped and time-bound — to Aldmoor surveillance aircraft transiting Vardland airspace over the Skarö cable route and the fuel-resupply corridor for the duration of the restoration window. Scope limits: corridor overflight and maritime-picture sharing only; data handled under the existing agreed surveillance scope; indications shared with Defence Command. The consent is renewable only by an express Cabinet decision and covers no other territory or purpose.

(2) Revised timeline: given the operational friction, please confirm the updated schedule for the repair vessel's arrival, full surveillance stand-up on station, and expected cable restoration, so the Cabinet, County, CCA and the public can manage fuel, berthing and expectations accurately.

(3) Scope control is unchanged: no ground forces; cable repair and corridor surveillance only. Any underwater-survey facilitation remains subject to a separate express Cabinet decision and is not authorised by this message.

(4) Coordination: route berthing, fuel and communications through the CCA–County interface so the response stays visibly civil-led. The Cabinet will facilitate within the consented scope.

From the Vardland Cabinet to the Drevnian Federation (deconfliction channel).

The repair of the Skarö cable now enters an extended window. As a practical safety measure and in the spirit of the transparency Vardland has already proposed, we will share the coordinates of the cable repair site and the civilian fuel-resupply corridor for the duration of the window, and we request that exercise manoeuvres avoid that defined area while civilian repair and fuel traffic are active, to prevent inadvertent interference and to keep the situation from escalating.

This is a reciprocal safety request, not a corridor regime and not a condition on lawful international exercise. We will issue equivalent avoidance instructions to our own forces and to the Aldmoor repair element with respect to Drevnan units.

We reaffirm our invitation to a joint, transparent cause investigation and our readiness to examine any evidence Drevna can provide. Vardland's position on the Protocol as tabled, and on Drevnan vessels or forces in Vardland territory, territorial waters or airspace, is unchanged.
